prompts.title: Root Cause Hypothesis
prompts.description: Diagnoses a failing test/stack trace and proposes ranked fixes.
prompts.author: asha.k
test_cases: Given a NullReferenceException stack trace + diff, returns 3 ranked fixes with code

prompts.title: Edge Case Reviewer
prompts.description: Reviews a proposed fix for missed edge cases and regressions.
prompts.author: asha.k
test_cases: Given a diff touching a retry handler, flags at least the idempotency risk

prompts.title: Few-Shot Commit Message
prompts.description: Generates a commit message matching team conventions from 2 examples.
prompts.author: asha.k
test_cases: Output matches conventional-commits format: type(scope): description

prompts.title: PR Description Generator
prompts.description: Generates a structured PR description from a diff and ticket link.
prompts.author: asha.k
test_cases: Output includes Summary, Changes, Testing, Risk sections

prompts.title: Daily Standup Summary
prompts.description: Generates a 3-line standup update from a day's commits/tickets.
prompts.author: asha.k
test_cases: Output has exactly 3 lines: yesterday, today, blockers

prompts.title: Incident Report Draft
prompts.description: Drafts a blameless incident report from timeline notes.
prompts.author: asha.k
test_cases: Output includes Impact, Timeline, Root Cause, Remediation sections; no blame language

prompts.title: Paper Summarizer
prompts.description: Summarizes a technical paper into TL;DR, contributions, and limitations.
prompts.author: asha.k
test_cases: Output includes a 3-sentence TL;DR and at least 3 limitations

prompts.title: Algorithm Comparator
prompts.description: Compares 2+ algorithms on complexity, tradeoffs, and use cases.
prompts.author: asha.k
test_cases: Output includes a comparison table with Big-O columns

prompts.title: Data Model Designer
prompts.description: Proposes a normalized schema from a set of user stories.
prompts.author: asha.k
test_cases: Output includes table definitions with primary/foreign keys

prompts.title: REST API Surface Generator
prompts.description: Generates REST endpoint definitions from a data model.
prompts.author: asha.k
test_cases: Output is valid OpenAPI-style YAML with request/response schemas

prompts.title: Unit Test Generator
prompts.description: Generates unit tests for a given function, including edge cases.
prompts.author: asha.k
test_cases: Output includes at least one null/empty-input test case

prompts.title: Release Notes Generator
prompts.description: Generates customer-facing release notes from a changelog diff.
prompts.author: asha.k
test_cases: Output avoids internal jargon and ticket IDs

prompts.title: Strategy Ideation
prompts.description: Proposes rule-based trading strategy candidates given constraints.
prompts.author: asha.k
test_cases: Output includes entry/exit rules and a risk statement per strategy

prompts.title: Backtest Result Analyzer
prompts.description: Analyzes backtest metrics for overfitting and risk red flags.
prompts.author: asha.k
test_cases: Flags Sharpe ratio inconsistent with max drawdown as a red flag

prompts.title: Compliance Language Checker
prompts.description: Flags user-facing trading copy that implies guaranteed returns.
prompts.author: asha.k
test_cases: Flags the phrase 'guaranteed returns' with high severity

prompts.title: Profile Onboarding Copy
prompts.description: Generates warm, inclusive onboarding copy for profile creation.
prompts.author: asha.k
test_cases: Output avoids gendered assumptions and age-based stereotypes

prompts.title: Message Moderation Classifier
prompts.description: Classifies a message for harassment/spam/safety risk before delivery.
prompts.author: asha.k
test_cases: Correctly flags a message containing an off-platform payment request as high-risk spam

prompts.title: Matching Explainability
prompts.description: Generates a human-readable explanation for why two profiles matched.
prompts.author: asha.k
test_cases: Output does not reference protected-class attributes directly

prompts.title: Style Guide Diff Reviewer
prompts.description: Reviews a diff against a team style guide document.
prompts.author: asha.k
test_cases: Flags a violation of a naming convention stated in the style guide

prompts.title: Reading List Generator
prompts.description: Produces an annotated reading list for a new technical concept.
prompts.author: asha.k
test_cases: Output includes 5+ sources each with a 1-sentence annotation

prompts.title: Strategy Diversity Checker
prompts.description: Detects near-duplicate strategies that differ only cosmetically.
prompts.author: asha.k
test_cases: Two MA-crossover strategies differing by a 1-day parameter return NEAR-DUPLICATE

prompts.title: Parameter Sensitivity Documenter
prompts.description: Documents behavioural fragility per parameter as an early overfitting signal.
prompts.author: asha.k
test_cases: A stop-loss set near typical daily volatility is flagged as fragile

prompts.title: Drawdown Explainer
prompts.description: Explains worst-drawdown period honestly, without minimising language.
prompts.author: asha.k
test_cases: An unrecovered drawdown produces output stating 'not recovered' explicitly

prompts.title: Disclaimer Completeness Checker
prompts.description: Verifies required disclaimers are present and not buried; reports status only.
prompts.author: asha.k
test_cases: Copy missing the paper-trading notice returns MISSING and a non-zero MISSING count

prompts.title: Regulatory Terminology Reviewer
prompts.description: Flags language implying licensed-advisor status or personalised advice.
prompts.author: asha.k
test_cases: Text containing 'suitable for you' is flagged with a proposed removal

prompts.title: Compliance Sign-off Request
prompts.description: Drafts a sign-off request to a named compliance reviewer with check results attached.
prompts.author: asha.k
test_cases: Output includes all three automated check results and a deadline framed as negotiable

prompts.title: Edge-Case Market Data Generator
prompts.description: Generates adversarial synthetic OHLCV data (flash crash, zero volume, gaps).
prompts.author: asha.k
test_cases: Generated zero-volume row causes the signal function to return 'no signal' rather than throwing

prompts.title: Strategy Documentation Generator
prompts.description: Plain-language explanation of a strategy, with no performance figures.
prompts.author: asha.k
test_cases: Output contains no percentage-return figures and a populated 'Struggles when' section

prompts.title: Glossary Term Definer
prompts.description: Plain-English definitions of trading jargon, with no good/bad threshold claims.
prompts.author: asha.k
test_cases: Definition of 'Sharpe ratio' contains no claim about what value is good

prompts.title: Bio Suggestion Generator
prompts.description: Generates bio options strictly from user-supplied facts, inventing nothing.
prompts.author: asha.k
test_cases: Given facts containing no personality adjectives, output contains no personality adjectives

prompts.title: Photo Policy Checker
prompts.description: Triages photo descriptions against policy; routes uncertain cases to humans.
prompts.author: asha.k
test_cases: A vague description ('a person outdoors') returns NEEDS-HUMAN-REVIEW, not LIKELY-COMPLIANT

prompts.title: Appeal Response Drafter
prompts.description: Drafts moderation appeal responses without leaking detection signals.
prompts.author: asha.k
test_cases: An upheld-appeal response names the policy clause but contains no threshold or signal detail

prompts.title: Fairness Regression Test Generator
prompts.description: Generates a CI test that fails on new match-rate disparity across subgroups.
prompts.author: asha.k
test_cases: A change moving one subgroup's match rate by 15% fails the test and names that subgroup

prompts.title: Trust & Safety FAQ Generator
prompts.description: User-facing moderation policy explanation, honest about limits, no evasion detail.
prompts.author: asha.k
test_cases: Output contains an honest limitation statement and no numeric threshold detail
